test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"burden"** implies a load or something heavy that one has to carry, which is relevant in the context of a backlog of unresolved academic work. 
 
• A backlog of pending doubts and unread material is considered a heavy load for students, which aligns with the concept of a** "burden."**
 
• Using** "burden" c**onveys the stress and pressure that accumulates when work is not completed on time, consistent with the passage's theme of maintaining regular study habits.
 
• The passage advises regular revision to prevent the accumulation of this load, further justifying the use of **"burden."**
 
• **"Burden" **accurately describes the feeling of being overwhelmed by an increasing amount of incomplete tasks, impacting study effectiveness and performance.
 
• It highlights the negative impact of procrastination, stressing the importance of consistent effort** to avoid such a heavy load.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mass:** Refers to the quantity of matter in an object; not commonly used metaphorically to describe academic backlog.
 
• **Weight: **While it also implies heaviness, "weight" doesn't fit the context as precisely as "burden" in describing accumulated workload.
 
• **Power: **Signifies strength or influence, which does not align with the theme of unresolved problems and workload.
